Here’s a quick roundup of some of the most highly‑rated crime‑thriller films released in 2020 (in no particular order):

| # | Title | Director | Notable Cast | Why It Stands Out |
|---|-------|----------|--------------|-------------------|
| 1 | **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A modern twist on the classic horror tale, it blends psychological suspense with social commentary on abuse and gaslighting. |
| 2 | **Tenet** | Christopher Nolan | John David Washington, Robert Pattinson | Though more sci‑fi, its intricate time‑travel plot and high‑stakes espionage make it a cerebral crime‑thriller. |
| 3 | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Aaron Sorkin | Eddie Redmayne, Sacha Baron Cohen | A courtroom drama that doubles as a political thriller, capturing the tension of the 1969 protest trial. |
| 4 | **The Hunt** | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau | A Danish film that examines paranoia and mob mentality, delivering a chilling narrative about false accusations. |
| 5 | **The Irishman** | Martin Scorsese | Robert De Niro, Al Pacino, Joe Pesci | A sprawling gangster saga that uses de‑scanning tech to weave a multi‑decade crime story. |

These films were praised for their storytelling, performances, and the way they kept audiences on edge throughout.
